title: This award-winning microscopy image used AI — igniting controversy in a prestigious competition
title_zh: 这幅屡获殊荣的显微镜图像使用了人工智能——在一项备受瞩目的竞赛中引发争议
abstract: Researchers say that using artificial-intelligence tools to visualize scientific images can become problematic when models misrepresent the underlying data.
abstract_zh: 研究人员表示，使用人工智能工具可视化科学图像可能会出现问题，当模型误代表底层数据时。
snippet: Researchers say that using artificial-intelligence tools to visualize scientific images can become problematic when models misrepresent the underlying data.
